hook: James Wise chairs the UK government's Sovereign AI Unit and is a partner at the venture firm Balderton Capital, according to the government's AI Opportunities Action Plan: One Year On report of 29 January 2026. The unit has up to £500 million; the Technology Secretary, Liz Kendall, launched the government's sovereign AI programme on 16 April 2026.
